note: LegiScan people_id to VoteApp candidate id for Hawaii. One file covers BOTH sessions in scope, the 2025 Regular Session (LegiScan 2175) and the 2026 Regular Session (2245): people_ids are stable across sessions, the two resolve runs proposed the same candidate for every person they both matched, and the union is 79 people (76 in 2025; Gedeon, Hartsfield and Ratcliffe arrived for 2026). Three entries were added by hand where the proposer's exact-name rule could not reach a nickname, a hyphen, or a middle name; each is corroborated by the district. Entries with a null candidate_id are deliberate: the local roster holds no November 2026 state-legislative candidacy for that member (the Senate seat is not up, or the member is not running, or the roster has not reached the race yet). Hawaii's own vote text names members by surname only; the mapping from surname to people_id happens in the fetcher, and this file maps people_id to candidate.
